definitions.explanation: Food preserved or flavored by exposure to smoke from burning wood or chips. Also refers to the process of smoking food. Common smoked foods include salmon, cheese, ham, and sausage.

examples.japanese: {燻製|くんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{燻製|くんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧です。
examples.english: My hobby is making smoked foods at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{燻製|くんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}したら→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧、⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧おいしく⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: When I tried making smoked food while camping, it turned out tastier than expected.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both for the smoking process and for the resulting smoked product. Home smoking has become a popular hobby in Japan, especially among camping and outdoor enthusiasts. Also written as {薫製|くんせい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {燻製|くんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make smoked food
- {燻製|くんせい}⟦サーモン→サーモン：08836_saamon⟧: smoked salmon
- {燻製|くんせい}⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧: smoked cheese
- {燻製|くんせい}{器|き}: smoker (device)
- ⟦{自家|じか}{製|せい}→自家製：13947_jikasei⟧{燻製|くんせい}: homemade smoked food
